bug_semantics: CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion in MessagePack-CSharp JSON conversion (not typed MessagePack deserialization). ConvertFromJson's FromJsonCore recursively walks nested JSON objects and arrays without consulting MessagePackSecurity.MaximumObjectGraphDepth, so attacker-controlled nesting can exhaust the call stack. TinyJsonReader.ReadNextToken self-recurses on comma and colon separators, so even malformed JSON with long separator runs consumes one stack frame per character before structural validation. ConvertToJson applies DepthStep to arrays and maps, but the typeless ext-100 branch recursively calls ToJsonCore without DepthStep, so nested typeless wrappers bypass UntrustedData. Each path yields an uncatchable StackOverflowException instead of a bounded parse/serialization failure.
flaw_origin: The still-vulnerable JSON-to-MessagePack conversion surface was first written on 2017-06-21 in 2b56a7c106feb7e16a7264042d3252f547bfe851 (neuecc): new Internal/TinyJsonReader.cs and FromJsonCore in MessagePackSerializer.Json.cs. FromJsonCore recurses on StartObject/StartArray with no depth counter (lines 76 and 88), and ReadNextToken handles ',' and ':' by calling itself (lines 147-151). Parent eb7184e49bd8781bb4ebc10c45a46b7c2d8ab694 has ToJson-only Json.cs and no Internal/TinyJsonReader.cs. Later writer/options/Unity-copy refactors preserved that unbounded recursion.
